#!/bin/bash
# Wait for eval PID 123605 to finish, then start seed123 training

    sleep 30
done

echo "Eval finished at $(date). Starting seed123 training..."

cd /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2

nohup python3 train_repo_cwm.py \
  --model_name /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-4B \
  --seed 123 \
  --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_repo_cwm_seed123/ \
  --no_wandb \
  --save_steps 100 \
  --eval_steps 100 \
  --device cuda:0 \
  > /root/autodl-tmp/cwm_seed123_train.log 2>&1 &

echo "CWM seed123 PID=$!" | tee /root/autodl-tmp/seed123_pid.txt
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/start_seed123_after_eval.sh
echo "SCRIPT_CREATED"
